description: For a token contract on base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis or celo: name, symbol, decimals, total supply (raw and decimal), code size, owner() if any, and whether it is an upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967 or legacy OpenZeppelin slots) with implementation and admin addresses. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/token-info.
name: token_info
title: ERC-20 token info + proxy check (8 chains)
